initialPlan.scope: Existing local media only; keyframe/common source shift candidates and MP4 end attribution
criteria: Unique or anchored packet mapping; unchanged payload
Video/audio source-output translation must be the same confirmed keyframe
Presentation starts and meaningful source offsets retained
Source/decoded video frames and durations match
Inspect mvhd/tkhd/mdhd/elst/ctts; distinguish media DTS span and presentation extent
Probe/decode and process termination independent from semantic pass
Timestamp-shift control selects corresponding packets
Noedit is a negative control, not a proposed policy
